auditor: Planning Worker 1 (Findings Validation & Audit Integrity Reviewer)
targetProductModel: Local Single-User Self-Hosted Developer Application (Localhost Execution)

findings.title: Grounding Agent Stages and Commits User Dirty Workspace Files
findings.description: GroundingAgent.run writes walking skeleton files directly into params.repoRoot and calls git.addAllExcluding without checking statusPorcelain, forcibly staging and committing uncommitted user files.
findings.rootCause: Omitting working directory status verification before executing stage-and-commit operations.
findings.remediation: Check git.statusPorcelain(params.repoRoot) before modifying files. Abort or isolate skeleton creation in an explicit worktree if dirty.

findings.title: Unconditional Lock Release Deletes Active Foreign Locks
findings.description: acquireDurableLock release callback unconditionally deletes lockPath directory without verifying lock ownership, allowing a process that exceeds timeout to delete active lock of another process.
findings.rootCause: Unconditional rm callback omitting owner validation.
findings.remediation: Inspect owner.json inside lockPath in release callback. Only delete lockPath if PID and acquiredAt timestamp match.

findings.title: V2 Execution Pipeline Leaks Worktrees and Branches on Exit
findings.description: driveClaimedExecutionV2 drives graph execution but omits calling worktrees.gcRun(runId) in its finally block on completion or failure, leaving orphan physical worktrees on disk.
findings.rootCause: Missing lifecycle cleanup barrier in execution coordinator pipeline wrapper.
findings.remediation: Wrap execution pipeline in try...finally to ensure worktrees.gcRun(runId) is executed unconditionally.

findings.title: Concurrent Git Operations Contend on .git/index.lock
findings.description: Concurrent git worktree add and ref deletion operations race on .git/index.lock without exponential retry/backoff, causing parallel task execution failures.
findings.rootCause: Direct execution of mutating Git commands without locking or retry handling for lock contention.
findings.remediation: Add exponential backoff retry wrapper for Git commands susceptible to .git/index.lock contention.

findings.title: Missing Fallback Git Committer Identity in SimpleGitRunner
findings.description: SimpleGitRunner.commit executes git commit without fallback user.name/user.email config parameters, crashing in fresh developer environments.
findings.rootCause: Assumption that host environment always has global Git identity pre-configured.
findings.remediation: Pass -c user.name="ManyHands Bot" -c user.email="bot@manyhands.local" default overrides on commit calls.

findings.title: WorktreeManager.clean Aborts Before Branch Deletion
findings.description: If worktreeRemove throws an exception during WorktreeManager.clean, execution halts before branch deletion, stranding temporary Git branches.
findings.rootCause: Sequential cleanup statements executed without individual try...catch isolation blocks.
findings.remediation: Wrap individual worktree directory removal and branch deletion in separate try...catch handlers.

findings.title: Windows Orphaned Physical Worktree Directory Deletion Failure
findings.description: WorktreeManager.clean relies solely on git worktree remove, which fails on Windows when background process file locks linger, leaving physical directories.
findings.rootCause: Windows file locking semantics preventing git worktree remove from deleting active directory handles.
findings.remediation: Add fallback recursive directory removal using fs.rm with retry backoff.

findings.title: Missing GPG Signing Override Causes Background Commit Hangs
findings.description: Background Git commit calls do not specify -c commit.gpgsign=false, causing execution to hang indefinitely when host Git config enables GPG signing globally.
findings.rootCause: Omitting explicit GPG signing suppression flags on automated background commits.
findings.remediation: Append -c commit.gpgsign=false to all automated Git commit options.

findings.title: Validation Worktree Setup Fails to Prune Untracked Files
findings.description: Validation worktree setup fails to prune untracked leftover files before checking out candidate commit diffs, distorting test results.
findings.rootCause: Assuming checkout over existing worktrees produces clean commit states.
findings.remediation: Invoke git clean -fdx prior to checking out target commits in candidate validation worktrees.

findings.title: Worktree Path Hashing Collisions on Identical Run Prefix Segments
findings.description: Short truncated hashing for worktree directory paths can produce collisions when run IDs contain identical prefix strings.
findings.rootCause: Truncating SHA-256 hash digests to short substring lengths without checking uniqueness.
findings.remediation: Use full 12-character hex digest slices combined with sanitized run IDs for worktree directory naming.

findings.title: Unparsed Stderr Strings on Successful Git Commands Output False Warnings
findings.description: Git outputs non-fatal informational messages to stderr. Parsing any non-empty stderr as an error generates false warning logs.
findings.rootCause: Checking stderr.length > 0 instead of exit codes to determine command success.
findings.remediation: Treat non-zero exit codes as errors and filter benign Git informational messages.

findings.title: gcRun Log Output Exposes Host Absolute Paths
findings.description: Log messages emitted during worktree garbage collection print unredacted absolute host filesystem paths, exposing host username in logs.
findings.rootCause: Direct interpolation of path.resolve strings into logger metadata.
findings.remediation: Relative-format or sanitize filesystem paths before printing to log streams.

findings.title: Hardcoded Git Binary Path Invocations Fail on Custom Windows Paths
findings.description: Directly executing git assumes Git exists on system PATH. When installed in non-standard Windows locations, process spawning fails.
findings.rootCause: Lack of dynamic executable location discovery for Git binary.
findings.remediation: Add dynamic Git binary resolution falling back to standard Windows installation paths.

findings.title: Transient Rename Retries Lack Delay and Leak .tmp Files
findings.description: JsonlRunEventStore.atomicWrite retries failed file renames in a synchronous loop without delay, failing transient Windows file locks and leaving temporary .tmp files stranded.
findings.rootCause: Retry loop lacking delay backoff and error cleanup.
findings.remediation: Add exponential backoff delay between rename attempts and unlink .tmp files in a catch block on failure.

findings.title: RunSnapshotStore.atomicWrite Lacks Retry Backoff Logic
findings.description: Writing snapshot state files uses single-shot atomic renames without retry logic, causing snapshot save failures on Windows under virus scan file locks.
findings.rootCause: Direct fs.rename invocation without lock retry wrapper.
findings.remediation: Shared renameWithRetry utility application across all store write handlers.

findings.title: Ephemeral Trace Logging via InMemoryTraceStore
findings.description: Duplicate finding of MH-AUDIT-QA-001. InMemoryTraceStore keeps diagnostic events strictly in memory, losing telemetry on process exit.
findings.rootCause: Duplicate domain registration.
findings.remediation: Remediated via primary finding MH-AUDIT-QA-001 (JsonlTraceStore).

findings.title: Degraded Event Log Handling Lacks Automatic Truncation
findings.description: When reading JSONL event logs containing corrupt trailing bytes from abrupt power loss, store throws unrecoverable parse error instead of truncating corrupt tail bytes.
findings.rootCause: Missing partial-write recovery and tail truncation logic.
findings.remediation: Implement inspect-and-repair log reader that truncates corrupt un-checksummed trailing lines.

findings.title: JsonlAttemptStore Lacks Status update() Method
findings.description: JsonlAttemptStore provides save() and get() but lacks an update() method, preventing attempt records created as created from transitioning to running, completed, or failed.
findings.rootCause: Incomplete persistence interface implementation.
findings.remediation: Implement update(runId, attemptId, patch) with atomic JSON rewriting.

findings.title: Process Evidence Journal Lacks Atomic File Writing
findings.description: Process evidence logs are written directly to disk via fs.writeFile without temporary file atomic swap, risking truncated JSON records on crash.
findings.rootCause: Direct non-atomic file write invocation.
findings.remediation: Refactor journal writers to use atomicWrite with .tmp file exchange.

findings.title: Missing Lock Heartbeat for Operations Exceeding 30 Seconds
findings.description: Durable lock stale threshold is 30 seconds. Long-running graph compilations exceeding 30s lose lock protection because no background heartbeat touches mtimeMs.
findings.rootCause: Fixed timeout threshold without background file modification touch loop.
findings.remediation: Add periodic fs.utimes heartbeat interval (every 10s) while lock is held.

findings.title: Missing fsync Call Before Rename in JsonlArtifactStore
findings.description: JsonlArtifactStore writes temporary files and renames without issuing fs.fdatasync()/fs.fsync(), risking lost writes during OS kernel panic.
findings.rootCause: Omitting explicit storage flush barrier before directory metadata rename.
findings.remediation: Flush file descriptor with fs.fsync before file rename.

findings.title: Snapshot Store Generates Redundant Temporary File UUIDs
findings.description: Every snapshot write generates a new random UUID string for .tmp filenames, creating high garbage collector string allocation churn.
findings.rootCause: Creating unique UUID strings per atomic write instead of reusing process-PID-based temp paths.
findings.remediation: Use fixed PID-based temporary file names (.tmp-pid-thread).

findings.title: DAG Cycle Validation Omits ArtifactRequirement Dependencies
findings.description: validateGraphRevision validates parent-child hierarchy cycles but completely omits ArtifactRequirement producer-consumer edge cycle checks. Circular artifact graphs pass validation and cause permanent deadlocks.
findings.rootCause: Incomplete graph validation logic missing cross-node artifact edge traversal.
findings.remediation: Construct adjacency matrix of artifact producer-consumer edges in validateGraphRevision and execute Kahn's cycle detection algorithm.

findings.title: Scheduler Ignores Compiled Graph-Level ConflictConstraints
findings.description: selectReadyWaveV2 evaluates artifact readiness and external conflict arguments, but execution-driver.ts never maps or passes GraphRevision.conflictConstraints compiled into the graph.
findings.rootCause: Disconnect between GraphCompiler output schema and wave selector input parameters.
findings.remediation: Map input.graph.conflictConstraints into the conflict constraint array inside selectReadyWaveV2.

findings.title: V2ExecutionDriver Parallel Driver Promise Mutation Race
findings.description: V2ExecutionDriver.advance mutates a single shared recording promise variable inside parallel node iteration loops, causing unhandled promise rejections when wave attempts fail.
findings.rootCause: Sequential promise chain mutation over concurrent async execution loops.
findings.remediation: Replace promise chain variable mutation with Promise.allSettled array collectors.

findings.title: Scope Isolation Critic Over-restriction Rejects File Edits
findings.description: reviewScopes in decomposer critics erroneously flags planned modifications to existing codebase files as scope violations, rejecting valid multi-file refactoring plans.
findings.rootCause: Scope critic treating existing target codebase paths as forbidden external paths.
findings.remediation: Adjust scope critic logic to allow existing target repository files within allowedPaths.

findings.title: Seam Binding Evaluation Omits Snapshot Artifact Hashes
findings.description: explainReadiness checks artifact contract presence but does not verify if output artifact hashes match required seam binding versions, permitting stale artifacts to satisfy readiness.
findings.rootCause: Presence-only checking without content digest verification.
findings.remediation: Verify artifact digest hashes in explainReadiness.

findings.title: Legacy Graph Adapter Embeds Mutable Runtime State in TaskNode
findings.description: Legacy graph compatibility adapter embeds mutable node runtime state inside TaskNode, violating target specification where GraphRevision is immutable.
findings.rootCause: Backward-compatibility layer preserving legacy node schema.
findings.remediation: Deprecate legacy graph adapter in favor of pure GraphRevision projections.

findings.title: Contract Compiler Generates Duplicate Artifact IDs
findings.description: When composite leaves share seam bindings, compileContractBundles generates identical artifact IDs for distinct contract bundles, causing artifact collisions.
findings.rootCause: Generating artifact IDs without appending composite leaf node IDs.
findings.remediation: Include leaf node ID in generated artifact contract ID strings.

findings.title: In-Flight Cancellation Fails to Interrupt Wave Promises
findings.description: When a human decision block or cancellation request arrives, active wave node execution promises continue running to completion before aborting the run.
findings.rootCause: Lack of AbortController signal propagation to active node promises.
findings.remediation: Pass AbortSignal to active wave promises and invoke immediate process tree termination.

findings.title: reviseGraph Lacks Revision ID Idempotency Validation
findings.description: Executing reviseGraph with duplicate operation sets produces incremented revision numbers without verifying revision content idempotency.
findings.rootCause: Missing content hash comparison against previous revision.
findings.remediation: Return existing graph revision if proposed operations result in identical graph state.

findings.title: Conflict Risk Score Rounding Drops Decimal Precision
findings.description: Conflict risk score calculation rounds intermediate float values to single integers, dropping fine-grained precision for risk ranking.
findings.rootCause: Math.round call on intermediate risk scores.
findings.remediation: Preserve 4-decimal float precision in risk score outputs.

findings.title: Environment Secret Leakage & Supervision in Planning V2
findings.description: Planning V2 process spawning calls supervisedSpawnFn (line 115), but passes raw env: process.env (line 117), leaking host secrets to CLI subprocesses.
findings.rootCause: Passing unfiltered host process.env instead of sanitized environment dictionary.
findings.remediation: Replace env: process.env with buildAgentEnvironment(process.env) to filter sensitive host keys.

findings.title: Path Traversal in Scope Enforcement
findings.description: ScopeChecker.check compares raw path strings against globs without resolving ../ path traversal sequences, permitting adversarial agent actions outside worktree.
findings.rootCause: String-only glob matching without path.resolve normalization relative to worktree root.
findings.remediation: Resolve target path against worktreeRoot using path.resolve and verify resolved.startsWith(worktreeRoot).

findings.title: Windows .cmd/.bat Flag Injection Vulnerability
findings.description: Escaping command arguments for cmd.exe /c on Windows with windowsVerbatimArguments fails to escape special characters (%, ^), allowing potential flag injection.
findings.rootCause: Complex Windows cmd.exe argument parsing edge cases.
findings.remediation: Standardize argument escaping and avoid cmd.exe wrappers when direct executable spawning is available.

findings.title: Lease Fencing Missing Process Abort Trigger
findings.description: Running agent process handles do not listen to lease revocation signals (repoLock.onLeaseLost), allowing processes whose lease expired to keep running.
findings.rootCause: Disconnected lease lifecycle listener.
findings.remediation: Wire repoLock.onLeaseLost to send immediate SIGTERM/SIGKILL signals to active process trees.

findings.title: Subprocess Tree Leak on Windows When Taskkill Fails
findings.description: When taskkill /t /f fails on Windows, fallback child.kill() kills only the parent Node process, stranding child CLI process trees.
findings.rootCause: Node child.kill() on Windows not terminating child process trees.
findings.remediation: Retry taskkill via PowerShell Get-CimInstance Win32_Process tree termination fallback.

findings.title: Permissive POSIX File Mode Masks on Lock and Temp Files
findings.description: Repository lock files and temporary atomic JSON files are created without explicit file mode permissions (e.g. 0o600), relying on host umask.
findings.rootCause: Omitting explicit POSIX mode flags in writeFile options.
findings.remediation: Pass { mode: 0o600 } on sensitive state file writes.

findings.title: Server SSE Stream Loop Ignores Client Disconnect Signals
findings.description: SSE stream handler does not listen to request.signal abort events. When HTTP connections drop without calling stream cancel(), background polling loop runs indefinitely.
findings.rootCause: Omitting request.signal.addEventListener('abort', ...) listener.
findings.remediation: Wire abort listener to set stream cancelled = true and clear polling timers.

findings.title: Unbounded Client Event Buffer & O(N^2) Refold Overhead
findings.description: Client-side SSE consumer buffers all historical run events in memory and re-executes full state reducer refolding on every incoming event message.
findings.rootCause: Full-array re-folding on single event push.
findings.remediation: Implement incremental state reducer in useLiveRunModel that applies delta events to current state snapshot.

findings.title: Decision Inspector Card Auto-Activation Failure
findings.description: Selecting a node with a pending human decision in the canvas does not automatically open the DecisionDetails inspector card.
findings.rootCause: Missing state selection trigger in UI component callback.
findings.remediation: Wire node click handler to activate decision drawer when node has pending decision.

findings.title: In-Memory Web Repository Cache Drifts From Disk Event Store
findings.description: Web application repository cache keeps run models in memory, drifting from on-disk JSONL event log updates during multi-process CLI runs.
findings.rootCause: In-memory cache missing file modification timestamp invalidation.
findings.remediation: Invalidate in-memory run cache based on event log mtimeMs checks.

findings.title: Concurrent Decision Resolutions Fail Without HTTP 409
findings.description: Submitting duplicate human decision resolutions fails silently without returning HTTP 409 Conflict status.
findings.rootCause: Missing optimistic concurrency check in decision resolution handler.
findings.remediation: Return HTTP 409 Conflict if decision was already resolved.

findings.title: Unauthenticated API Endpoints Across Web Application
findings.description: Initial audit flagged missing session auth across web API routes. Under ManyHands Local Model, multi-user OAuth is OUT_OF_SCOPE_SAAS. The local requirement is strict 127.0.0.1 interface binding and CSRF / Origin header validation.
findings.rootCause: Evaluating local desktop tool against cloud multi-tenant security requirements.
findings.remediation: Enforce 127.0.0.1 binding in Next.js host and validate Origin/Host headers to prevent local browser CSRF.

findings.title: Workspace Path Validation Permits Non-Existent Paths
findings.description: Registering a new workspace accepts arbitrary path strings without verifying filesystem directory existence.
findings.rootCause: Missing fs.stat verification in API route handler.
findings.remediation: Validate that provided workspace path exists and is a valid directory.

findings.title: Pick Folder Endpoint Native OS Dialog Execution
findings.description: Endpoint triggers native OS GUI file dialog via pickFolderNative(). Under local single-user model, native file pickers are legitimate local features, but require origin protection.
findings.rootCause: Unvalidated local endpoint triggering native GUI thread.
findings.remediation: Restrict endpoint to local loopback origins with custom CSRF request header.

findings.title: Xterm Terminal Addon Memory Leak on Rapid Tab Switching
findings.description: Rapidly switching tabs in run view leaves un-disposed @xterm/addon-fit event listeners, creating memory leaks.
findings.rootCause: Missing addon.dispose() cleanup in React useEffect.
findings.remediation: Add explicit dispose() cleanup call in terminal component unmount.

findings.title: Missing SSE Reconnect Backoff Delay
findings.description: On EventSource disconnect, client immediately retries connection without backoff, flooding local web server during server restarts.
findings.rootCause: Instant reconnect loop in client EventSource error handler.
findings.remediation: Implement exponential reconnect backoff delay (1s, 2s, 4s, max 10s).

findings.title: Initial SSR Page Load Flashes Empty State
findings.description: Page SSR renders empty state before SSE stream connects and populates initial run snapshot data.
findings.rootCause: Page component omitting initial server-side snapshot hydration data.
findings.remediation: Pass initial run snapshot as server prop to hydrate client state immediately.

findings.title: Off-Grid CSS Spacing Classes Break Visual Token Consistency
findings.description: Non-standard Tailwind class names (mt-2.5, p-5.5) break visual token grid consistency and cause unit test regex failures in pnpm test.
findings.rootCause: Arbitrary Tailwind value usage.
findings.remediation: Replace off-grid spacing values with standard Tailwind design tokens.

findings.title: Run Cancellation Endpoint Returns 200 OK Before Process Tree Cleanup
findings.description: /api/runs/[id]/cancel sends abort signal and returns HTTP 200 OK immediately before waiting for process supervisor to confirm process tree termination.
findings.rootCause: Asynchronous fire-and-forget cancellation response.
findings.remediation: Await processSupervisor.killRunProcesses(runId) barrier before responding.

findings.title: Missing WCAG 2.2 Aria-Labels on Drawer Close Buttons
findings.description: Node detail drawer close icon buttons lack accessible aria-label tags.
findings.rootCause: Omitting accessibility attributes on icon-only buttons.
findings.remediation: Add aria-label="Close node details panel" to drawer close buttons.

findings.title: Activity Feed Timestamps Lack Timezone Formatting
findings.description: Activity log items display raw ISO timestamp strings without localized timezone formatting.
findings.rootCause: Rendering unformatted date strings.
findings.remediation: Format timestamps using Intl.DateTimeFormat.

findings.title: Indirect Prompt Injection Vector via Unsanitized Files
findings.description: Repository code snippets read by RepositoryIndexer are interpolated directly into LLM prompt strings without XML escaping envelope tags. Adversarial comments in cloned repositories can inject system prompt overrides.
findings.rootCause: String interpolation of untrusted codebase text into prompt templates.
findings.remediation: Enclose all user file content in strict XML envelope tags (<user_file_content path="...">) and sanitize closing tags.

findings.title: Uncapped Token Budget & Unmetered LLM API Invocations
findings.description: LLMDecomposer executes prompt completion calls without checking per-run maxBudget spending limits, allowing runaway API costs on looping decomposition attempts.
findings.rootCause: Omitting token budget tracking in LLM completion client calls.
findings.remediation: Track cumulative input/output token usage in RunCoordinator and enforce hard token spending caps.

findings.title: Unrestricted Execution Capabilities in MCP Sidecar Wrappers
findings.description: MCP sidecar wrapper tools execute arbitrary shell commands without parameter validation or execution scope checks.
findings.rootCause: Unrestricted tool execution wrappers.
findings.remediation: Implement tool call allowlist and validate arguments against run execution scope.

findings.title: Missing Retry Backoff on Provider Rate Limit HTTP 429 Errors
findings.description: LLM provider API calls failing with HTTP 429 Rate Limit throw immediate unhandled exceptions without exponential backoff retry.
findings.rootCause: Missing rate-limit error handler wrapper.
findings.remediation: Implement exponential backoff retry with jitter on HTTP 429 response codes.

findings.title: Prompt Logs Write Unredacted Sensitive Text to Disk
findings.description: Debug prompt logging writes unredacted raw prompt text including code snippets and potential local API keys to plain-text log files.
findings.rootCause: Direct unredacted string logging.
findings.remediation: Filter known secret patterns (API keys, tokens) before persisting prompt logs.

findings.title: Structured JSON Output Parsing Relies on Fragile Regex Fallback
findings.description: When LLMs return non-compliant JSON responses, graph compiler attempts regex extraction, which frequently fails on nested markdown code blocks.
findings.rootCause: Fragile regex fallback for malformed JSON parsing.
findings.remediation: Enforce structured JSON mode / tool use schema parameters in LLM requests.

findings.title: High Context Window Overhead From Unpruned AST Dumps
findings.description: Submitting complete un-pruned AST snapshot dumps to LLMs inflates prompt context window sizes, increasing latency and cost.
findings.rootCause: Including verbose AST nodes instead of focused symbol outlines.
findings.remediation: Prune AST representations to export top-level function/class signatures.

findings.title: Workspace Specifier Inconsistencies Across Monorepo Manifests
findings.description: Internal monorepo package dependencies use explicit version numbers instead of standard pnpm workspace:* specifiers, breaking local linking.
findings.rootCause: Hardcoded version strings in package manifests.
findings.remediation: Standardize all monorepo internal dependencies to workspace:*.

findings.title: Missing Explicit tsup devDependency in Package Manifest
findings.description: packages/task-graph/package.json relies on root tsup binary without listing tsup in its own devDependencies.
findings.rootCause: Implicit root dependency hoisting assumption.
findings.remediation: Add "tsup": "^8.0.0" to package devDependencies.

findings.title: apps/web/tsconfig.json Path Overrides Bypass Dist Declarations
findings.description: Path mappings in apps/web/tsconfig.json force TypeScript to compile package src/* files directly instead of consuming compiled dist type declarations.
findings.rootCause: Direct source file path aliases in web application TSConfig.
findings.remediation: Remove direct src/* path overrides in apps/web/tsconfig.json so web consumes built package declarations.

findings.title: Root Build Script Excludes apps/web
findings.description: Root pnpm build script executes package builds but omits apps/web:build, requiring developers to run separate build commands.
findings.rootCause: Incomplete root build script pipeline definition.
findings.remediation: Update root pnpm build script to include web application build.

findings.title: Monorepo Uses EOL ESLint v8 Toolchain
findings.description: Monorepo config uses deprecated ESLint v8 format with legacy .eslintrc files instead of ESLint v9 flat config (eslint.config.js).
findings.rootCause: Legacy linter configuration.
findings.remediation: Upgrade toolchain to ESLint v9 flat configuration format.

findings.title: Phantom Dependency on ts-morph
findings.description: Code comments in repository-index reference ts-morph AST parser, but dependency is omitted from package.json.
findings.rootCause: Outdated code comment referencing unused library.
findings.remediation: Clean up obsolete comments or add missing type dependency.

findings.title: React Type Definition Mismatch (@types/react@18 vs react@19)
findings.description: apps/web specifies react@19 runtime dependency but specifies @types/react@18 in devDependencies, generating type check warnings.
findings.rootCause: Mismatched major version numbers between runtime and type definitions.
findings.remediation: Upgrade @types/react and @types/react-dom to match React 19.

findings.title: Missing Frozen Lockfile Verification in CI
findings.description: CI install steps execute pnpm install without --frozen-lockfile, allowing lockfile drift across environments.
findings.rootCause: Omitting strict lockfile enforcement flag in CI scripts.
findings.remediation: Pass --frozen-lockfile in automated CI installation tasks.

findings.title: Inconsistent ECMAScript Compilation Targets Across Packages
findings.description: Monorepo packages specify varying TSConfig target settings (ES2022 vs ESNext).
findings.rootCause: Un-shared base TSConfig settings.
findings.remediation: Standardize target compilation level to ES2022 in root tsconfig.base.json.

findings.title: Unused Root @types/node Version Mismatch
findings.description: Root package.json specifies @types/node@18 while sub-packages target Node 20+ APIs.
findings.rootCause: Legacy root package manifest entry.
findings.remediation: Align root @types/node version to Node 20 LTS.

findings.title: Ephemeral Trace Logging Causes Telemetry Evaporation
findings.description: Diagnostic trace events are logged exclusively into InMemoryTraceStore which is never written to disk, losing diagnostic logs on process exit or crash.
findings.rootCause: Memory-only trace store implementation.
findings.remediation: Implement JsonlTraceStore in packages/trace-store to persist trace events to disk files (*.traces.v2.jsonl).

findings.title: Zero Component/DOM Unit Tests for Web Application
findings.description: apps/web contains zero React Testing Library unit tests or Playwright E2E browser tests for canvas UI interactions.
findings.rootCause: Missing web UI test suite setup.
findings.remediation: Add Vitest + React Testing Library suite for key web UI components.

findings.title: Fragile UI Tests Rely on Exact Code String Matching
findings.description: UI component unit tests read TSX source files as raw text strings via fs.readFileSync and check exact class name regexes, failing 2 tests in pnpm test when Tailwind formatting changes.
findings.rootCause: Testing source code formatting strings instead of rendered JSX DOM output.
findings.remediation: Refactor tests to render React components using Testing Library and fix Tailwind spacing class tokens in UI components.

findings.title: Missing Package-Level test Scripts & Obsolete Vitest Globs
findings.description: packages/*/package.json manifests omit test scripts, and vitest.config.ts uses obsolete glob patterns that skip sub-package integration tests.
findings.rootCause: Missing package script definitions and outdated Vitest include globs.
findings.remediation: Add "test": "vitest run" to all package manifests and update root Vitest include patterns.

findings.title: Windows File-Lock Lockouts Cause Integration Test Flakiness
findings.description: Integration tests creating and removing temporary worktrees hit Windows file locking delays, relying on global test retry: 1 workarounds.
findings.rootCause: Synchronous test cleanup running before process handles release worktree directory locks.
findings.remediation: Implement async retry wrapper in test teardown fixtures.

findings.title: Server Error Loggers Suppress Stack Traces
findings.description: Server API error loggers log error.message strings without printing full error stack traces, complicating local debugging.
findings.rootCause: Logging string messages instead of error objects.
findings.remediation: Print error.stack in server error log outputs.

findings.title: Event Store Read Errors Fail Silently
findings.description: Internal filesystem read errors during event store parsing are caught and suppressed without emitting diagnostic trace events.
findings.rootCause: Empty catch blocks in store event parser.
findings.remediation: Emit diagnostic trace events whenever event store reads encounter errors.

findings.title: LLM Fallback Tests Rely on Mocks Without Negative Controls
findings.description: Tests verifying LLM fallback behavior mock successful completions without testing malformed or failing LLM response paths.
findings.rootCause: Omitting negative test cases in mock test suite.
findings.remediation: Add negative test fixtures for malformed LLM responses.

findings.title: Test Execution Reporter Lacks Structured Export Options
findings.description: Vitest configuration uses default console reporter without configuring JUnit or JSON test result export.
findings.rootCause: Basic test reporter configuration.
findings.remediation: Add JSON reporter option to Vitest configuration.

findings.title: Missing Event Store Compaction Subsystem
findings.description: Long-running runs accumulate tens of thousands of JSONL events. No compaction or snapshot truncation subsystem exists, increasing startup replay time linearly.
findings.rootCause: Missing event log pruning mechanism.
findings.remediation: Implement event log compaction that truncates historical events prior to verified RunSnapshot checkpoints.

findings.title: Durable Diagnostic Trace Store Missing
findings.description: Duplicate finding of MH-AUDIT-QA-001. Trace logging is memory-only.
findings.rootCause: Duplicate domain registration.
findings.remediation: Remediated via primary finding MH-AUDIT-QA-001.

findings.title: Artifact DAG Cycle Validator Missing
findings.description: Duplicate finding of MH-AUDIT-ORCH-001. Graph revision validation omits artifact requirement dependency cycles.
findings.rootCause: Duplicate domain registration.
findings.remediation: Remediated via primary finding MH-AUDIT-ORCH-001.

findings.title: Multi-Language Repository Indexer (TS/JS Only)
findings.description: AST snapshotting in RepositoryIndexer is implemented exclusively for TypeScript/JavaScript, falling back to basic regex symbol extraction for Python, Rust, or Go.
findings.rootCause: Single-language AST parser implementation.
findings.remediation: Add Tree-sitter or multi-language regex parser fallbacks for Python, Go, and Rust.

findings.title: Incremental Snapshot Delta Folding Unbuilt
findings.description: SnapshotStore recalculates full state snapshot objects from event zero instead of applying state deltas incrementally.
findings.rootCause: Full-state snapshot projection.
findings.remediation: Implement incremental delta applier for snapshot updates.

findings.title: Worktree & Artifact Garbage Collection Subsystem Uncalled
findings.description: Duplicate finding of MH-AUDIT-GIT-001. Execution pipeline omits worktrees.gcRun(runId) cleanup calls on exit.
findings.rootCause: Duplicate domain registration.
findings.remediation: Remediated via primary finding MH-AUDIT-GIT-001.

findings.title: Web API Authentication & Middleware Unbuilt
findings.description: Duplicate finding of MH-AUDIT-API-006. Unauthenticated Web API endpoints.
findings.rootCause: Duplicate domain registration.
findings.remediation: Remediated via primary finding MH-AUDIT-API-006.

findings.title: O(N^2) Event Store Append Re-Write Loop Under Heavy Loads
findings.description: JsonlRunEventStore.append() reads the complete historical event log file into memory, appends the new event, and re-writes the entire file to disk on every event write, causing severe O(N^2) disk IO degradation.
findings.rootCause: Read-append-rewrite implementation instead of streaming file append handles.
findings.remediation: Refactor append() to use true file append streams (fs.appendFile or persistent append file handles).

findings.title: 3x Physical Git Worktree Disk Overhead Per Node Attempt
findings.description: Creating physical worktree clones without shared git object hardlinks consumes ~3x repository disk size per executing node attempt.
findings.rootCause: Standard git worktree add without shared object cache optimization.
findings.remediation: Use Git alternate object stores or hardlink options when spawning worktrees.

findings.title: O(N^2) Pairwise Conflict Risk Matrix Calculation
findings.description: ConflictRiskAnalyzer performs exhaustive pairwise file path comparisons across all graph nodes on every wave step.
findings.rootCause: Naive double-loop file path comparison algorithm.
findings.remediation: Index node path scopes in a inverted file-to-node map for O(1) overlap lookups.

findings.title: Web UI Event Refolding O(E^2) Client Re-Render Overhead
findings.description: Web client refolds complete event history array on every incoming SSE chunk, freezing UI on large runs.
findings.rootCause: Full array re-fold in React client state hook.
findings.remediation: Apply delta events incrementally to active React state.

findings.title: Snapshot Store Deserializes Full Blobs Without LRU Cache
findings.description: RunSnapshotStore.get() reads and parses full JSON snapshot files from disk on every query without an in-memory LRU cache.
findings.rootCause: Disk read per snapshot query.
findings.remediation: Wrap RunSnapshotStore.get() in a 50-item LRU memory cache.
